notes: Linn is 50 ft from 8th to Kenyon (centre x~2651-2676) but south of Kenyon it is a separate 20 ft street (printed 20', labelled LINN) sharing only the east face, centre x~2732; it runs Kenyon to Hathaway and is recorded as two T points at Kenyon. Jane is printed 36' north of Hathaway (faces 3295/3428) and 30' south of it (faces 3324/3432); it runs from Kenyon south to West 6th and does not continue north of Kenyon or south of 6th. Hathaway ends at Jane (T); Wingate Alley crosses Jane on its diagonal and continues east onto sheet 40. The narrow (~10-11 ft) alley with a water pipe running east from Jane at y~3225 is the straight branch of Wingate Alley (printed WINGATE ... ALLEY on sheet 40, which runs it Jane to Cutter); it is recorded as a T on Jane named 'Wingate Alley (Jane to Cutter)' to keep it apart from the diagonal Wingate Alley, which keeps the plain name. Baymiller widens on its east side south of Wingate Alley to a printed 90' at West 6th (east face diagonal from ~x1125 y4250 to ~x1195 y4400); the Baymiller/6th point keeps the regular Baymiller centreline (west face 865, pipe 945), not the middle of the flare. West 8th: only the south face is on the sheet (y~347 at Baymiller, ~330 at Linn; the sheet is slightly rotated), centre computed 100 px north. West 6th: only the north face is on the sheet west of the bend (y~4400), centre computed 110 px south for the 66 ft width; on the diagonal both faces are drawn. Streets run very slightly off-axis (y drops ~17 px from Baymiller to Linn).
